metadata.title: K-HNSW External Benchmarks & Scalability Evaluation
metadata.author: Member 4 (Saanvi Srivastava, Benchmarks Lead)
metadata.description: Empirical benchmark evaluations across synthetic Gaussian drift (ef_construction=16 and ef_construction=200), real Texmex SIFT embeddings, and SIFT-like synthetic clustered fallbacks.
metadata.decision_rule_contract: Win if (recall_a - recall_b >= 0.02) OR (recall_a >= recall_b - 0.01 AND cost_a <= cost_b * 0.5)
metadata.hnswlib_baseline_status: Native C++ AVX baseline measurements designated for Linux CI runner (Windows emulation excluded).
